addition-subtraction-1000-skill-01.target: I can round a whole number to the nearest 10 by finding the two tens it is between and deciding which is closer.
addition-subtraction-1000-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can round a whole number to the nearest 10 by finding the two tens it is between and deciding which is closer.
addition-subtraction-1000-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Rounding down every time, or changing the hundreds digit when rounding to the nearest ten. Try this: Place the number on a number line between the two tens; a 5 in the ones place rounds up.

addition-subtraction-1000-skill-02.target: I can round a whole number to the nearest 100 by finding the two hundreds it is between and deciding which is closer.
addition-subtraction-1000-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can round a whole number to the nearest 100 by finding the two hundreds it is between and deciding which is closer.
addition-subtraction-1000-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Looking at the ones digit instead of the tens digit, or rounding 350 down. Try this: Underline the hundreds digit, look only at the tens digit, and check with a number line.

addition-subtraction-1000-skill-03.target: I can add within 1,000 using place value strategies and the standard algorithm, regrouping when needed.
addition-subtraction-1000-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can add within 1,000 using place value strategies and the standard algorithm, regrouping when needed.
addition-subtraction-1000-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Forgetting to regroup, or lining up digits by the left edge instead of by place. Try this: Use base‑ten blocks or a place-value chart; trade 10 ones for 1 ten and record the regrouped ten.

addition-subtraction-1000-skill-04.target: I can subtract within 1,000 using place value strategies and the standard algorithm, including across zeros.
addition-subtraction-1000-skill-04.ifCorrect: You can do this: can subtract within 1,000 using place value strategies and the standard algorithm, including across zeros.
addition-subtraction-1000-skill-04.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Subtracting the smaller digit from the larger digit in each place (“smaller from bigger”). Try this: Model with base‑ten blocks: when there are not enough ones, unbundle a ten. Check by adding.

addition-subtraction-1000-skill-05.skill: Estimating to Check Sums and Differences
addition-subtraction-1000-skill-05.target: I can round to estimate a sum or difference and decide whether an exact answer is reasonable.
addition-subtraction-1000-skill-05.ifCorrect: You can do this: can round to estimate a sum or difference and decide whether an exact answer is reasonable.
addition-subtraction-1000-skill-05.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Treating the estimate as the exact answer, or rounding each number to a different place. Try this: Estimate first, solve, then compare: is the exact answer close to the estimate?
